note.en: About 100.4%. A near perfect match, since all of its universal Electric DMG bonuses apply to him in full. It does need Basics to keep up, but his aimed shot and Ha-Oto no Ya count. With CRIT Rate buffs such as from Nicole it overcaps after one substat roll, so it can underperform in practice.

The reference option (100%). It gives fantastic CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG as permanent bonuses, an extra 40% Electric DMG on Dash Attacks and a CRIT Rate boost after any squad member applies an Anomaly or Stuns.
About 99%. His quiver hits count as Basic Attacks and he constantly uses Dash Attacks, so it can be very strong. It takes some ramp-up, but builds fast.
About 95%. A great stat stick for most characters, with a tremendous amount of unconditional CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG.
About 92%. A decent stat stick with a significant amount of CRIT DMG, but that is all it offers. He cannot use non-EX Specials before combos.
About 90%. A solid free-to-play option for all Attack agents. It gives 25% unconditional Attack and a further 19.2% Combat Attack after a Dodge Counter or Quick Assist.
